Container.Name: tandoor-mcp
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Tandoor Recipes. Exposes recipe search, creation, shopping lists, meal planning, and pantry management as AI tools for Claude and other MCP clients. Uses Streamable HTTP transport on the /mcp endpoint. Add as a Claude custom connector at https://your-host:3091/mcp (no OAuth required). TANDOOR_AUTH_TOKEN is strongly preferred over username/password — Tandoor limits the login endpoint to 10 requests/day per IP. Get a token via: curl -X POST http://your-tandoor/api-token-auth/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"your-pass"}' To gate the connector with a key (recommended for public exposure): configure your reverse proxy to require a query param (e.g. ?key=YOUR_SECRET) and give Claude the full URL including the key. See project README for the Nginx/NPM config snippet.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Streamable HTTP MCP port. Claude connector URL: http://[IP]:[PORT]/mcp

Config.Name: TANDOOR_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Full URL of your Tandoor instance, reachable from inside this container.

Config.Name: TANDOOR_AUTH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Pre-existing Tandoor API token (tda_...). Preferred — bypasses the 10-req/day login rate limit. Leave blank to use username/password instead.

Config.Name: TANDOOR_USERNAME
Config.Description: Tandoor username. Only used when TANDOOR_AUTH_TOKEN is not set.

Config.Name: TANDOOR_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Tandoor password. Only used when TANDOOR_AUTH_TOKEN is not set.

Config.Name: BIND_ADDR
Config.Description: Address and port the server listens on inside the container. Change only if you remap the container port above.

Config.Name: RUST_LOG
Config.Description: Log verbosity: error, warn, info, debug, or trace.
